summary: Hand-written fixes for the Lune booking journey, in the same shape Devin returns. Date availability gets words and a pattern, the date chips and Reserve become real keyboard-operable buttons with a visible focus ring, the seat stepper and dates get 40-44 px targets, the booking page reflows at 200% zoom with the booking card under the dates, and the checkout total gets readable contrast.

fixes.title: Say which dates are sold out in words, not only in red and green
fixes.description: December dates are available (green) or sold out (red), and that colour is the only difference: same luminance, no text, no icon, and a colour-only legend. With red-green colour blindness every chip looks the same, so the user picked the first date, which was sold out, and ended up on a waitlist (total EUR 0.00) instead of a booking. Add an 'Open' / 'Sold out' label in each chip, stripe and strike out sold-out dates, and say it in the legend and the accessible name.
fixes.code_change: In poc/demo_startup/server.py date_strip(), render the status as text inside each chip, e.g. 10Open or ..."Sold out", give each chip an accessible name such as aria-label="Thu 10 Dec, seats available", and render the legend as words with a striped swatch. In lune.css add a stripe pattern and line-through for .day.is-full so the state never depends on hue alone. Better still: disable sold-out dates or label them 'Waitlist'.

fixes.title: Make the date chips and 'Reserve' real buttons, with a visible focus ring
fixes.description: The date chips and the 'Reserve' button are <div onclick> elements: they are not in the Tab order and Enter or Space does nothing, so a keyboard user can neither pick a date nor book. On top of that, `*:focus { outline: none }` hides where the focus is (2.4.7 Focus Visible). Use <button> elements (one Tab stop for the date group, arrow keys between dates), a submit button for 'Reserve', and a clear :focus-visible outline.
fixes.code_change: In server.py date_strip(), render each bookable date as <button type="button" class="day ..." data-date=... aria-pressed="false"> instead of <div onclick>, and in workshop_page() replace <div class="reserve-cta" onclick="reserve()"> with <button type="submit" class="reserve-cta">. In booking.js, attach the click handler with addEventListener, keep a roving tabindex on the date group with arrow-key navigation, and validate the date in a submit listener. In lune.css, delete `*:focus { outline: none }` and add `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1b4dd8; outline-offset: 2px }`.

fixes.title: Enlarge the seat stepper and date targets
fixes.description: The seat stepper's '-' and '+' are 14x14 px and touch each other (1 px divider), and the date chips are 18x18 px with 2 px gaps. With a slightly imprecise pointer, clicks miss or land on the neighbour: the wrong seat count or the wrong date. WCAG 2.2 asks for at least 24x24 px; make the stepper buttons 44 px with 8 px between them and the dates 40 px in a calendar grid.
fixes.code_change: In lune.css set `.stepper button { width: 44px; height: 44px }` with `.stepper { gap: 8px }`, and lay the dates out as a 7-column calendar (`.date-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 40px); gap: 8px }`) with `.day { width: 40px; height: 40px }`.

fixes.title: Let the booking page reflow at 200% zoom
fixes.description: The workshop page is a fixed 1240 px grid inside an `overflow-x: clip` wrapper, with `overflow-x: hidden` on html and body. At 200% zoom the viewport is about 640 px wide, so the booking card (seats, total, 'Reserve') is cut off on the right and cannot be scrolled to: the low-vision user could not book at all. Make the layout fluid and stack the booking card right under the date picker on narrow viewports.
fixes.code_change: In lune.css replace `.booking-shell { width: 1240px }` with `max-width: 1240px; width: 100%`, remove `overflow-x: hidden` from html.page-booking/body and `overflow-x: clip` from .clip, and add a breakpoint (max-width: 1000px) that switches .booking-shell to a single column with grid-template-areas placing the booking card after the date section, `position: static` for the card, and a wrapping date strip.

fixes.title: Give the checkout total readable contrast and size
fixes.description: The price details on the checkout, including the total, are 12 px light grey (#cdc6bb on #fffcf7, about 1.7:1). WCAG asks for 4.5:1. The most important number on the page is unreadable with low vision. Use dark text and make the total the most prominent line.
fixes.code_change: In lune.css set `.price-details { color: #3f3a34; font-size: 15px }` and `.price-details .price-total { color: #1d1a16; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700 }`.
